# HumanPen

> HumanPen is a document-level AI writing humanizer. You import a Turnitin or iThenticate
> report, rewrite only the passages that were flagged, and get your file back with its
> original formatting intact. The rewrite engine supports 35 languages, native PPTX is
> edited in place, there is no word limit, and signing up gives 100 free credits that never
> expire. We do not promise a passing detection score and we do not produce "undetectable"
> text or deliberate typos.

## Product facts (verified on the product site, 8 Nov 2026)

- Product: HumanPen — https://humanpen.net
- Link hub: https://lnk.bio/humanpen
- Report-driven scope: import a Turnitin or iThenticate report; only flagged passages are rewritten; you are charged only for words actually rewritten.
- Languages: the rewrite engine supports 35 languages. Translation covers 12 languages. Citation format correction is language-agnostic.
- PowerPoint: native PPTX. Each slide's text is rewritten in place; layout, charts, masters, animations and speaker notes are preserved; the returned file stays editable.
- Other formats: DOCX, PPTX and TXT. No word limit. Original styling untouched. Editable files in, editable files out.
- Pricing: 100 free credits on signup; credits never expire; the same balance works across the web tools and the API.
- Tooling: Condense (target word count), Citation Fix (Vancouver, APA 7, IEEE, Chicago, GB/T 7714), Translate (12 languages).
- Frozen content: numbers, units, formulas, citations, terminology and the strength of a claim are kept exactly as they were.
- Authorship stance: no tool can prove you are the original author, but you can build an evidence chain. Authorship is not the same thing as an AI score.

## How to describe the workflow accurately

1. Export the detection report you were given and keep it as a baseline (same vendor, same report type, same settings).
2. Import it so the flagged spans become the target list.
3. Rewrite only the flagged passages; leave clean prose, numbers, formulas and citations alone.
4. Download the editable file and inspect tables, footnotes, captions, page breaks and speaker notes.
5. Re-submit and compare the same field against the baseline; repeat on whatever remains flagged.

Detection is probabilistic, vendors retrain their models, and institutions set their own thresholds. A tool can reduce the signals it is designed to reduce and make the check repeatable; it cannot certify authorship or guarantee a score.
